inputSchema.description: Request model for listing CalculatedMetrics on a property.

pageSize.description: Optional. Maximum number of results to return per request. Default: 50, Maximum: 200
pageSize.title: Page Size

pageToken.description: Optional. Token from a previous response for pagination to retrieve the next page of results
pageToken.title: Page Token

parent.description: Required. Property identifier in format 'properties/{propertyId}'. Example: 'properties/1234'
parent.title: Parent

inputSchema.title: ListCalculatedMetricsRequest

calculatedMetricId.description: The API name for the calculated metric
calculatedMetricId.title: Calculated Metric Id

description.description: Description for the calculated metric. Max 4096 characters
description.title: Description

displayName.description: Display name shown in Google Analytics UI. Max 82 characters
displayName.title: Display Name

formula.description: The metric's calculation formula. Max 5 unique referenced custom metrics
formula.title: Formula

invalidMetricReference.description: Indicates if metric contains invalid references
invalidMetricReference.title: Invalid Metric Reference

metricUnit.description: Type of the metric's value. Values: STANDARD, CURRENCY, FEET, MILES, METERS, KILOMETERS, MILLISECONDS, SECONDS, MINUTES, HOURS
metricUnit.title: Metric Unit

restrictedMetricType.description: Types of restricted data. Values: COST_DATA, REVENUE_DATA
restrictedMetricType.title: Restricted Metric Type

nextPageToken.description: Token for retrieving next page. Omitted if no more results available
nextPageToken.title: Next Page Token
